counter.label: her atomic weight for radium, 1902 (226 today)

connections.why: The physics frame tells how Becquerel found uranium's rays in 1896; Marie Curie turned those rays into a measured current, and the measurements led her and Pierre Curie to polonium and radium.
Joachimsthal, whose silver mines Agricola described, later gave the Curies the pitchblende residues from which they drew radium.
